user.title: LG NetCast HDCP TV
user.description: Enter the IP address of the television. The TV must be on and connected to the same network as Home Assistant.

pair.title: Pair with the TV
pair.description: The TV at {host} should now display a {length}-character pairing key. Enter it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with the TV
reauth_confirm.description: The TV at {host} rejected the stored pairing key. Turn the TV on and enter the {length}-character key shown on screen.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the TV
reconfigure.description: Update the IP address of the television.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV. Check the IP address, network, and that the TV is on.
error.invalid_auth: The TV rejected the pairing key.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname.
error.invalid_key: The pairing key must be six letters or digits.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while talking to the TV.

abort.entry_not_found: The config entry no longer exists.
